pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions showing soft, smooth pixel-level gradients at the edges rather than sharp transitions. The shapes on the lower neck and flank are varied in size, with some exhibiting elongated vertical orientations.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-colored inter-patch pathways forming a continuous grid with visible tri-point junction nodes. The pixel thickness of these corridors is narrow and consistent, creating a clear topological separation between dark regions.
